notes: Compatible with batches 002 and the 60-character review. Rarity and role scores are omitted; RARITY-0.2 and SCORE-1.0 derive them.
No character was checked against the primary manga. secondary_source_confirmed means a fan wiki, news site or official anime site agreed; it is not primary verification.
Only a minority of evidence leads were checked in this session; the rest are recollection and are labelled recollection_only.
Every record is Draft or Held. Three records are Held (Dan Kato, White Zetsu, Mabui).

characters.name: Neji Hyuga
characters.canonical_version: War-era Neji (Fourth War arc, until his death): Byakugan, Gentle Fist, Eight Trigrams Heavenly Spin
characters.justification: Byakugan and Gentle Fist specialist with sound tactical reading; his shield technique and final interception protect allies, though the fatal act is a one-time demonstration.

evidence_leads.lead: Fourth War arc: shields and intercepts an attack for Naruto and Hinata
Sasuke Retrieval arc: defeats Kidomaru

characters.canonical_version: War-era Hinata: Byakugan, Gentle Fist, Twin Lion Fists

evidence_leads.lead: Pain's Assault arc: attacks Pain and takes a blow meant for Naruto
Fourth War arc: fights beside Naruto, Byakugan support
